features: With a display that's 38%* bigger than a smartphone and a design that fits perfectly in the palm of your hand, Redmi Pad SE 4G ensures that you are always ready for action.
Be it roadtrips, vacations or even browsing social media at your nearby cafe-no matter where you are, always stay connected with 4G.
Pair up your Redmi Pad SE with the cover* which doubles up as a quick stand.
The large 6650mAh battery ensures long hours of use without frequent charging.
description: The Redmi Pad SE 4G tablet is an extension of you, always ready for action. Its standout feature is 4G+4G calling, making it a versatile device for both calls and data. Immerse yourself in smooth visuals on the 90Hz refresh rate display while enjoying rich audio with dual speakers and Dolby Atmos. The large 6650mAh battery ensures long hours of use without frequent charging. For added protection and style, the Redmi Pad SE Cover is the perfect companion. The slide and stand cover makes it a piece of cake to use it on the go, and keep it stationery on the table.
